verdict.rationale: Turso's official CLI documents database creation (`turso db create`), connecting and shelling in (`turso db shell my-db`), and broad database management from the command line, plus dumping a database through the shell. Dedicated inspection commands (listing databases, showing details, URLs or usage) are not evidenced, so the 'inspect' part of the daily loop is only implied, and there is no hands-on corroboration that the CLI removes the need for the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit inspect/list/show commands, independent hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free daily workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: Congratulations, you created a database! Now connect to it with the `shell` command
The Turso CLI gives you everything you need from the command line to manage your database, API tokens, inviting users, and launching the database shell.
